
# Copilot Instructions

## Project Overview
This project is a Student CGPA Performance Management System written in Python.

## Coding Standards
- Use Python 3.12 or compatible Python 3.
- Follow PEP 8 conventions.
- Keep functions small, readable, and focused.
- Use meaningful variable and function names.
- Add type hints where appropriate.
- Use clear error messages and validate inputs.
- Keep the line length within 88 characters.
- Format code with Black and check it with Ruff.

## Testing
- Use pytest for automated testing.
- Place tests in the tests/ directory.
- Name test files test_*.py and test functions test_*.
- Test normal cases, boundary cases, and invalid inputs.
- Run tests after making code changes.

## Project Structure
- src/: application source code
- tests/: automated tests
- docs/: project documentation
- config/: project configuration
- README.md: project overview and instructions

## Responsible AI Use
- Treat AI-generated code as a suggestion, not as automatically correct.
- Review code before accepting changes.
- Never expose passwords, access tokens, API keys, or private personal data.
- Do not invent test results or claim tests passed without running them.
- Explain significant changes and preserve existing functionality.
